title: Git Pal repository policy
description: Auto review and approval rules shared by everyone reviewing this repository with Git Pal.

enabled.description: Set to false to stop auto reviews. Only turns them on for users following repository policies without a matching template.

skip_labels.description: Labels keeping a pull request from being auto reviewed, added to the template's. Case, spaces, dashes and underscores are ignored.

skip_approved.description: Skip pull requests whose required reviews are already met.

claim_for_team.description: Assign the reviewer so teammates in the requested code owner team skip the pull request.

enabled.description: Set to false to stop auto approvals. Never turns them on for a template with auto-approve off.

max_risk.description: Highest risk auto approved, the lower of this and the template's applies.

require_green_ci.description: Approve only once CI checks pass.

skip_paths.description: Globs from the repository root. A pull request changing a matching file is never auto approved. `*` stays within a folder, `**` crosses folders.
